notes:
- **Windows and Linux builds.**

- **Move to…** in the sidebar's right-click menu — send the selected images to any folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a clash becomes "name 2".
- **Folders with no images are hidden** in the sidebar, so only folders worth opening are listed.
- One click opens an image from the sidebar.

- **The sidebar no longer jumps when you click.** Opening an image or a folder used to scroll the list immediately, moving the row out from under the pointer — so a single click read as nothing happening.

**Installing from the DMG?** Drag Peek to Applications, then run this once in Terminal:

```bash
xattr -cr /Applications/Peek.app
```

Updates from inside Peek do not need it.
